name: mosaic-compile
description:
Compile a .mosaic component file to a target output format.

Reads the unified .mosaic file format (interface + layout + style in one file)
and emits to the specified backend.

Also supports a `pkg` subcommand for compiling an entire Mosaic component
package (a directory with mosaic-package.toml + src/) per UI29 §4.3.

flags.description: Output backend: 'webcomponent' (Custom Element JS) or 'html' (static HTML file)
Path to a JSON fixture file providing slot values (for --backend html)
Path to a CSS file to inline in the HTML output (for --backend html)
Path to a .mil mosmodel interface file (three-file pipeline mode)

Path to a .mll moslayout file (three-file pipeline mode). If this points at a DIRECTORY (UI30 multi-layout), the file is resolved as <Component>.<variant>.mll inside it, with fallback to bare <Component>.mll. The component name comes from the --interface file's component declaration; --variant picks the variant.
Path to a .msl mosstyle file (three-file pipeline mode)

UI30 layout variant name (e.g. desktop, touch, tablet, tv, print). Only meaningful when --layout points at a directory — resolves <Component>.<variant>.mll inside. Falls back to bare <Component>.mll if the variant file isn't found. Omitting --variant is equivalent to --variant default (= bare <Component>.mll). Ignored with a warning when --layout points at a file.
For --backend xaml: also emit a full WinUI 3 host shell (csproj + App + MainWindow + manifest + build.ps1 + README) next to the component triple. Resulting directory is buildable as-is.

Optional path to a `mosaic-package.toml` that the current .mil/.mll/.msl belongs to. When set, the backend's component-reference resolver auto-registers every name in `[components].exports` so the .mll can reference sibling components from the same package (e.g. Field referencing Input).

UI34 — colon-separated list of directories to search for mosaic-package.toml manifests. Used by the package-reference resolver to locate packages named in `pkg::P::C` references. Defaults to `code/packages/` relative to the current working directory; set this when invoking mosaic-compile from a different root.

arguments.name: SOURCE
arguments.description: Path to the .mosaic source file to compile (legacy single-file mode). Omit when using --interface/--layout/--style or the `pkg` subcommand.

commands.name: pkg
commands.description: Compile every component in a Mosaic package to a per-backend artifact tree (UI29 §4.3).

flags.description: Directory under which <backend>/ is created (mkdir -p applied)
Also emit the selected backend's runnable project shell alongside the package artifacts

arguments.name: PACKAGE_ROOT
arguments.description: Path to the package directory (must contain mosaic-package.toml)
